name: Al-Khalid (MBT-2000)
protection: Composite armour with ERA on Al-Khalid I. Game: immune to all small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, external stowage, fuel drums and tracks (mobility kill on repeated hits); PG-7V/AT4/MAAWS/SMAW/NLAW penetrate side, rear and turret roof; Javelin top-attack penetrates; frontal arc resists unguided launchers.
visual_notes: Chinese Type 90-II derived: wedge turret with flat add-on armour front
Six road wheels per side, side skirts
Ukrainian 6TD-2 engine (rear deck grilles) on early batches
